# API Contracts

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Not applicable in this repository

No server API surface exists. The digest reports `api_surface.present: false`. There is no `server/api` directory, no route handlers, no controllers, no OpenAPI/GraphQL schema; routing is Nuxt file-based with a single page (`app/pages/index.vue`). The only interactive form (`app/components/sections/ContactSection.vue`) is client-only — `onSubmit` sets a local `submitted` flag with no network request. Likewise `async.present: false` — no queues, brokers, or message formats. The site's only outbound HTTP is static-asset/font fetching (Google Fonts) and generated SEO artifacts (`sitemap.xml` via `@nuxtjs/sitemap`, JSON-LD via `nuxt-schema-org`), none of which are consumable API endpoints defined by this repo.
